name: Stand-Up India
body: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
summary: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading.
benefit: Composite loan covering 75% of project cost

name: PM-DAKSH Skill Development Scheme
body: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Free short-term and long-term skill training for SC, OBC, EBC, DNT and sanitation workers to improve employability and self-employment readiness.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
summary: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh under Shishu, Kishor and Tarun categories for non-farm micro and small enterprises.

name: National SC/ST Hub Scheme
summary: Handholding support for SC/ST entrepreneurs including capacity building, credit facilitation, and access to the 4% GeM/CPSE procurement quota.

name: Mahila e-Haat
body: Ministry of Women and Child Development
summary: Online marketing platform for women entrepreneurs and self-help groups to showcase and sell products directly to buyers.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
summary: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises, with higher subsidy rates for SC/ST/OBC/women/differently-abled applicants.

name: Seed Fund Scheme for Minority Entrepreneurs (NMDFC)
summary: Low-interest micro-financing for minority community entrepreneurs through state channelising agencies.

name: Venture Capital Fund for SC/ST (IFCI)
body: IFCI Ltd, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
summary: Equity/quasi-equity support for scalable, growth-stage SC/ST-owned enterprises with viable business models.

name: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI)
summary: Free residential skill training and post-training handholding for rural youth to start micro-enterprises or find self-employment.

name: TREAD Scheme for Women
summary: Grants for NGOs to provide credit, training and counselling support to non-farm women entrepreneurs.
